packageRules.groupName: GitHub Actions minor and patch updates

packageRules.description: The types follow the lowest Node version Habblaud supports (engines: >=22.12). Majors are bumped by hand, together with engines and CI.
The image stays on an LTS version of Node. Changing the major version (e.g. 24 -> 26) is done by hand.
CI runs on the lowest supported Node version (node-version: '22.12' in ci.yml, same as engines). It is bumped by hand, together with engines.
